atAGlance: Cơm gà xối mỡ is crispy fried chicken over rice, often with chicken-fat fragrance, pickles, cucumber, and a muối tiêu chanh, a lime-pepper salt dip. It is about crisp skin against hot rice.
whatItIs: Cơm gà xối mỡ is fried or oil-crisped chicken over rice, often with pickles, cucumber, scallion oil, and a light broth or lime-pepper salt on the side.
usuallyIncludes: muối tiêu chanh, a lime-pepper salt dip
howToEnjoy: Eat the chicken skin while it is still crisp, then use pickles and cucumber to cut the richness. Lime-pepper salt is for small dips, not for covering the rice.
howLocalsOrder: Order cơm gà xối mỡ when you want crispy chicken with rice. Ask for extra pickles, less oil, or lime-pepper salt on the side if you want more control.
worthKnowing: Cơm gà xối mỡ is a useful bridge dish for travelers: fried chicken and rice feel familiar, while the chicken-fat aroma, pickles, and lime-pepper salt make it distinctly Vietnamese.
goodToKnow: Xối mỡ points to hot fat/oil poured over the chicken for crispness. It is not a sticky-rice dish.
